content:
Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the straight angle along the left semicircle from \(B\) to \(A\) is \(180^\circ\).

The angles on that side satisfy
\[
40^\circ+\text{(shaded sector angle)}+30^\circ+45^\circ=180^\circ.
\]
Thus the shaded sector has central angle
\[
180^\circ-40^\circ-30^\circ-45^\circ=65^\circ.
\]

For a point chosen uniformly from the entire disk,
\[
P(\text{shaded})=\frac{\text{area of shaded sector}}{\text{area of disk}}
=\frac{65^\circ}{360^\circ}
=\frac{13}{72}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{13}{72}}
\]
